description: Source code for pooling operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including adaptive and max pooling functions for 1D, 2D, and 3D tensors.

methods.name: check1d
methods.description: Utility function to check if a 1D tensor argument has size 1.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool1d
methods.description: Performs 1D adaptive average pooling by internally using 2D pooling.

methods.name: adaptive_max_pool1d
methods.description: Performs 1D adaptive max pooling by internally using 2D pooling.

methods.name: max_pool1d_with_indices
methods.description: Performs 1D max pooling with indices, wrapping 2D max pooling.

methods.name: avg_pool1d
methods.description: Performs 1D average pooling by internally using 2D pooling.

methods.name: max_pool2d
methods.description: Performs 2D max pooling, with support for quantized, MKL-DNN, and XNNPACK backends.

methods.name: max_pool3d
methods.description: Performs 3D max pooling, with support for quantized and MKL-DNN backends.
